story.festival_christmas.name: Christmas
story.festival_christmas.desc: A Christmas challenge: find and scan twenty-five different fir trees, then light up your base.
story.festival_christmas.ch.c1.sum: Fir trees grow on the cold worlds. Scan twenty-five different ones.
story.festival_christmas.r1.start: Merry Christmas! In many homes a fir tree full of lights stands in the living room tonight. Find twenty-five different fir trees and scan them — then I have presents for you.
story.festival_christmas.graduated: Merry Christmas! Here are presents to wrap and coloured lamps for your base.
story.festival_christmas.d1.start: Fir trees grow on the cold worlds — tundra, taiga, glacier. Scan twenty-five different ones with the hand scanner; every tree counts once.
story.festival_christmas.d1.done: Twenty-five fir trees! A whole Christmas forest.
story.festival_christmas.d2.start: Put up ten lights at your base — lanterns, coloured lamps, paper lanterns, light strips.
story.festival_christmas.d2.done: Ten lights — your base is shining.
